description: Click an element by CSS selector, scrolling into view and auto-waiting up to 5 seconds (MutationObserver). Returns clicked tag name and text. When a mouse click press lands but the page changes before release so the target is missed, nothing is clicked again and the first line is JSON {"clicked": false, "reason": "moved"|"gone"|"unknown"} (isError stays false): check page state before retrying.

selector.description: CSS selector; chain into an iframe or shadow root with '>>>' (e.g. 'iframe#card >>> .inner')

name: browser_click
